bugs_found: fx_convert adds 1 to amount before multiplying, over-crediting every non-identity conversion
transfer is not atomic: debit is committed before credit, so a failure during credit leaves balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, allowing TypeError or mixed numeric behavior
compound_interest silently truncates non-integer years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without error
loan_payment silently truncates non-integer months via int(), changing repayment schedule without error
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount
